summary: Comprehensive test suite with three well-organized layers (unit tests, integration via act, workflow structure validation) that cover all retention policies, dry-run mode, error handling, and end-to-end pipeline execution. Strong coverage of requirements and core functionality. Gaps include limited edge-case scenarios (special characters in names, extreme size values, identical timestamps), only 3 fixture scenarios tested, and no explicit testing of missing dependencies (powershell-yaml) or workflow step failures. Integration tests are brittle to exact output format changes and some unit tests verify implementation details rather than behavior. Would reliably catch most regressions but some edge cases could slip through.
